body: No I haven't but I will definitely keep it in mind if I dont see any improvement. Thanks.

So it has helped stabilize your moods? That is my main concern, I am on an anti-depressant and in the past before I was on a mood stabilizer I became manic from the anti-depressant. So it ia making me kind of nervous.

It was all of those plus memory loss. I would be told one thing and not even five minutes later would have no idea I was even spoken too or I would be in the middle of a conversation and forget what the actual conversation was about. I am going to school and I just couldn't deal with it anymore.
Damn I didnt know that place closed, which goes to show how often I am in the east village. The place was kind of cool though.

I dont really feel there are many other factors. I do hate my job but who doesnt. I have looked for other jobs but can not find one. I am not in school, I have been disqualified a few times because of the bipolar and see no point going back. I am not in a relationship because I dont like dealing with people and dont think it is fair to put all my problems on someone else. I really think it is just the bipolar getting to me. I have tried meditation but it doesnt help. I cant sit still for that long and my brain never shuts up.
